mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rbac_user ( id, account_id, username, password_hash, display_name, email, mobile, status, deleted, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{accountId}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{mobile}, #{status}, #{deleted}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, username, password_hash, display_name, email, mobile, status, deleted, create_time, update_time FROM rbac_user WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, account_id, username, password_hash, display_name, email, mobile, status, deleted, create_time, update_time FROM rbac_user WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND username = #{username} LIMIT 1
mapper.update:
UPDATE rbac_user
password_hash = #{item.passwordHash},
display_name = #{item.displayName},
email = #{item.email},
mobile = #{item.mobile},
status = #{item.status},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND id = #{item.id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE rbac_user SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
